title: 247쪽 · ating Out of Position
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: $5-$10NL: Hero raises to $30. The Button raises to $100. Hero reraises to $250. The Button calls. Hero should 4-bet A-K. Calling the 3-bet allows Villain to realize most of his equity. It also makes it difficult for Hero to realize all of his equity. He's going to have to check-fold the flop about half the time. Why sacrifice equity by calling the 4-bet when he can generate fold equity by 5-betting?
Hero checks. Villain checks. bag reys rarery tee Pr tha iad ny vow tr amy and
susiiie: cai and plan on folding to any hag
